simple.meaning: בֶּהָלָה (behâlâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “panic , destruction.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֶּהָלָה (H928) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 26:16, with occurrences in Leviticus, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֶּהָלָה (H928) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֶּהָלָה (H928) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֶּהָלָה (behâlâh) / H928 is traced through Leviticus 26:16, Psalms 78:33, Isaiah 65:23, Jeremiah 15:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

timeline.evidenceText: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.
Therefore he consumed their days in vanity,
They will not labor in vain
Their widows are increased more than the sand of the seas.

definitions.full: H928. behalah ֶבּהָלָה noun feminine dismay, sudden terror or ruin (compare Assyrian bêltu , terror , Dl Pr 32 ) — ׳בּ absolute Lev 26:16 2 t.; plural וֶּבהָלוֺת Jer 15:8 ; — sudden terror Lev 26:16 בּ עֲלֵיכֶם ׳וְהִפְקַדְתִּ֫י (appositives follow); compare Jer 15:8 ; Isa 65:23 לַבֶּהָלָה יֵָֽלְדוּ לֹא , Psa 78:33 בַּבֶּהָלָה וּשְׁנוֺתָם יְמֵיהֶ֑ם וַיְכַלבַּֿהֶבֶל and he ended their days in a breath, and their years in sudden terror. בהם (Arabic , IV. shut , x. impeded in speech, tongue-tied ; Ethiopic be dumb ).
